lineage: Generated independently with built-in imagegen; every raster was copied into this shard and inspected with view_image before labeling.

xb01_poster_gallery.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic empty contemporary museum gallery, large framed wall poster with printed photographs of people, exactly zero real people, no mirrors or reflections containing people, glass cases, polished floor.
xb01_poster_gallery.png.observed_vs_intended: Observed empty gallery; poster contains human figures but is visibly flat printed media, as intended.
xb01_poster_gallery.png.uncertainties: Poster subjects must not be counted as live visitors.

xb02_statue_visitor.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic museum gallery with exactly one adult visitor standing beside one clearly matte stone or plaster human statue, no mirrors, no extra people.
xb02_statue_visitor.png.observed_vs_intended: One live visitor and one distinct stone statue are visible; no extra people.
xb02_statue_visitor.png.uncertainties: Visitor is oriented toward the exhibit, not reliably toward the robot.

xb03_three_overlap.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic museum gallery with exactly three real adult visitors close together with partial overlap, all heads distinguishable, two front-oriented and one profile, no extra people.
xb03_three_overlap.png.observed_vs_intended: Three distinguishable visitors are visible, with two frontal and one profile.
xb03_three_overlap.png.uncertainties: Body orientation is observable; attention/readiness is not.

xb04_edge_crop.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic museum corridor with exactly two real adult visitors, one partially cropped by the left image edge and one fully visible on the right, no mirrors or extra people.
xb04_edge_crop.png.observed_vs_intended: Exactly two live visitors appear; one is edge-cropped and one is whole.
xb04_edge_crop.png.uncertainties: The frame says nothing about people outside the image.

xb05_long_corridor.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic long museum corridor with exactly two real adult visitors far down the hall, countable but too distant for reliable gaze or facing direction, no mirrors or extra people.
xb05_long_corridor.png.observed_vs_intended: Two small distant visitors are visible near the corridor end; their orientation is genuinely uncertain.
xb05_long_corridor.png.uncertainties: Do not fabricate facing_robot_count or attention from the distance.

xb06_backlit_window.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic museum gallery with exactly two real visitors beside a bright window, one facing camera and one with back to camera, realistic controlled backlighting, no extra people.
xb06_backlit_window.png.observed_vs_intended: Two visitors are visible; one is front-oriented and one back-oriented, with readable exposure.
xb06_backlit_window.png.uncertainties: Orientation is used as a proxy only; attention is not observable.

xb07_dim_gallery.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic dim museum gallery with exactly three readable real adult visitors, moderate digital noise, one front-oriented, one profile, one away, no extra people.
xb07_dim_gallery.png.observed_vs_intended: Three readable visitors appear in a dark, moderately noisy gallery with distinct orientations.
xb07_dim_gallery.png.uncertainties: Noise limits fine-grained claims; attention/readiness remains unknown.

xb08_phone_distractors.png.generation_prompt: Photorealistic bright contemporary museum gallery with exactly two real visitors, one holding a phone and looking down, one clearly oriented toward camera, information screens and glass cases as distractors, no human photos.
xb08_phone_distractors.png.observed_vs_intended: Two visitors are visible; one looks down at a phone and the other faces the camera, with screens/cases present.
xb08_phone_distractors.png.uncertainties: Phone posture does not establish attention; only orientation is labeled.
